limits: Chromium and Linux WebKit automation with phone emulation; no physical Safari/iPhone measurements.
Jewel is a baked WebP animation, not a new live WebGL benchmark. The Aurum optical calculations are retained, with gemstone output alpha adjusted from 0.76 to 0.96.
Model generation uses the explicit existing UI fixture; no new GPU inference or model quality benchmark.
Land accent inference covers explicit Add clauses and basic land subtypes; it is not a complete Oracle rules interpreter.
